scripts.deploy:prod: wrangler deploy -e prod --outdir dist --upload-source-maps --var SENTRY_RELEASE:${SENTRY_RELEASE} --var APP_VERSION:${APP_VERSION} --var GIT_SHA:${GIT_SHA}
scripts.deploy:dev: wrangler deploy -e dev --outdir dist --upload-source-maps --var SENTRY_RELEASE:${SENTRY_RELEASE} --var APP_VERSION:${APP_VERSION} --var GIT_SHA:${GIT_SHA}
scripts.deploy:staging: wrangler deploy -e staging --outdir dist --upload-source-maps --var SENTRY_RELEASE:${SENTRY_RELEASE} --var APP_VERSION:${APP_VERSION} --var GIT_SHA:${GIT_SHA}
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: sentry-cli releases new $SENTRY_RELEASE --org=$SENTRY_ORG --project=$SENTRY_PROJECT && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org=$SENTRY_ORG --project=$SENTRY_PROJECT --release=$SENTRY_RELEASE --strip-prefix 'dist/..' dist && sentry-cli releases finalize $SENTRY_RELEASE
